lastCommit.message: Morning ingest: six questions minted where the world is thinnest, each with its proposal in the same commit

barRaise.topFinding: The BLOCK is open: preview.json and search-index.json are unauthenticated 200 surfaces that leak every secret entity's name, and preview.json additionally leaks spoiler subtypes (e.g. "campaign arc"), live-confirmed by two independent lenses today; a brand-new bold-autolink leak vector resolves gated hrefs into public prose with zero build-gate coverage, and release.ps1 never checks any data-path surface, only the DM-locked page path. Beneath the BLOCK the release pipeline is in poor shape: a missing Cloudflare token still prints "Release complete" after skipping deploy and every live check, the shared portfolio git-guard was never adopted, and the pre-staging git-guard bug makes the one check that would catch a leaked secret a structural no-op on every push. Both v0.5 deliverables shipped days ago but the milestone tracker still reads 55% from 2026-07-06 while a 1,710-item art batch not the declared priority absorbed most of the week's commits. Health dropped from 67 to 49 across 19 lenses, with five lenses scoring under 30.

actions.title: Add ctx to fetch and refresh the answer snapshot in ctx.waitUntil; live-measured 6.64s stall on cache-miss reproduced today.
Wire the item catalog's provenance field through to a /catalog OGL 1.0a license panel; it is currently stripped before reaching the browser and zero license text exists anywhere on the site.
Throw instead of WARN when the Cloudflare token file is missing; a release that skips deploy and every live check still prints "Release complete."
Add live assertions to release.ps1 for /api/answers, /preview.json, and /search-index.json against secret-qids.mjs; none of the three data-path surfaces are checked today (root cause of the BLOCK).

BLOCK: preview.json's `t` field is unconditional (unlike search-index.json's `st`) and exposes secret entities' spoiler subtypes (e.g. "campaign arc") live; gate it the same way search-index.json already does.
Same as performance-01 (duplicate root cause, different lens): add ctx/waitUntil so the answer-snapshot rebuild never runs in-band.
Extract one shared vault-reader module (parseFrontmatter, slug, qhash) and import it everywhere; 20 entities still resolve two different URLs across build.mjs/audit.mjs/site_slug.py.
Split web/build.mjs (now 9,717 lines, +22% in a week) along its own commented seams before it crosses 10k lines.
Move shop state/ledger off two single global KV keys (no CAS) onto per-key writes or a Durable Object; concurrent purchases can clobber each other.
Move the version-pill/CHANGELOG commit+push to after live checks pass; a mid-release failure now makes reruns silently report "Nothing to release."

BLOCK: preview.json and search-index.json are unauthenticated (200) and serve every secret entity's name (both) and subtype (preview.json) to anonymous requests; release.ps1 never checks a data-path surface.
Reject character:"DM" on /api/sticky, /api/note, and non-DM-routed /api/answer unless a valid DM session/password is present.
Extract the inlined page shell (CSS+menu+scripts, now ~131KB, up from 72.7KB) into hashed cached /assets files instead of repeating it on all 1,375 pages.
Register kv-snapshot.mjs as its own scheduled task and fail the lore audit when the newest snapshot is over 36 hours old.
Refuse a KV snapshot write on a >5% answer-count drop and raise KEEP past 7.
Promote CODE-06 from warn to a build defect with a ratchet at today's 9,717-line count; consolidate 14+ duplicated client-side esc() copies.
Export routeQuestion from a shared module imported by build.mjs and the lore audit; the hand-copied mirror already let DM questions defect to the player board once.
Fail the release when the generated secret-qids list drops below 80% of the previously deployed count.
Both v0.5 deliverables (campaigns board, proficiency tracker) shipped 2026-08-03/04; re-anchor completion.pct (still reads 55%/2026-07-06) and have Kane name the next milestone.
Adopt the canonical portfolio git-guard (Assert-GitSafe/Invoke-Git/Confirm-GitIntact); Gnosis still ships only the old secret-scanner under that name.
Move the git-guard secret scan in push-to-github.ps1 to after `git add -A`; it currently inspects an empty staging area every push.
Same git-guard pre-staging bug as release-pipeline-ps1-stack-02 (duplicate root cause, different lens): the only gate that would catch a committed webhook URL is a structural no-op.

Bold-name autolinking (**Name**) resolves to real hrefs for secret entities with zero LEAK-gate coverage (only [[bracket]] syntax is scanned); live-confirmed on characters/maevyn.html linking to gated /characters/kazo.
Add a post-generation GATE build defect that re-reads every JSON/HTML under dist for gated identifiers; redaction is convention with no enforced contract.
Accept a ?qids= param on /api/answers; confirmed live today the param is silently ignored and the full store still ships every time.
Add failed-attempt backoff shared across all 12 GATE_PASSWORD comparison sites, not just /dm-login; the DM gate password has unlimited guesses everywhere.
Stop the answer-snapshot rebuild from fanning out one KV get per stored answer; store has grown 2x past the prior ceiling.
Register tools/kv-snapshot.mjs as its own scheduled task independent of the ingest routine, with a staleness alarm.
Invert /api/answers filter to an allow-list from the player board so an unrecognized qid fails closed instead of being served.
Gate the preview.json fetch behind first hover/touch, matching the lazy pattern already used for search-index.json.
Add a package.json with node --test covering the four pure functions that encode locked decisions.
Default the DM board's unanswered-only filter to ON; a 5-10 item daily job still ships 1,281 rows and 1.1MB of HTML.
Move the open-question guard above the proposal branch in renderDraft so a settled question can never render an Approve box.
Prune web/proposed-answers.json when a question flips to [x]; 525 of 565 entries are dead weight, growing daily.

Serve /api/answers/export from the cache; three separate daily scripts each independently pay a ~1,720-read full scan (confirmed 3x worse than originally scoped, but downgraded since KV growth is flat and the free cap is not at risk).
Derive BUILD_STAMP from a content hash instead of wall-clock time so an unrelated edit stops busting the 37MB globe cache.
Record known-good wrangler/Node majors and fail loudly in release.ps1 when the installed major differs.
Add a pinned requirements.txt for Pillow/numpy/scipy; scipy gates two locked check chains and is documented nowhere.
Log the KV key and operation in the ~17 remaining silent catch blocks in web/worker.js.
Post lore-audit severity counts to the existing webhook on non-zero exit or rising warn count; append each run to a committed trend file.
Replace CODE-07's cross-drive git-pathspec probe (always throws into a silent-pass catch) with a filesystem mtime check on K:\~DnD.
Let build/deploy/live-check always run on rerun instead of exiting on "Nothing to release" after a mid-release failure.
Make discord-notify.ps1 exit non-zero on a missing webhook or failed POST with a visible NOTIFY FAILED line.
Skip the Discord release post and completion banner when deploy did not actually run.
Replace four stale scaffold .gitignore webhook lines with a glob; none of the five real per-topic webhook filenames are covered today.
Add a commit+push block to write-dashboard-status.ps1; status/data/Gnosis.json is a full release behind and dirty in the YaE repo.
Emit the version pill into the built footer and assert it live in release.ps1, which today only checks feature markers, never the version.
Apply the .menu-dm hiding treatment to secret rows in type-index/directory pages (/characters/, /lore/, /adventures/), which list every secret entity in plain visible text today.
Materialize a pre-serialized public-only snapshot key so anonymous /api/answers is one get with no parse/filter/stringify.
Add a limits block to wrangler.jsonc and wrap the loadAnswers KV walk in a try/catch with a degraded fallback.
Emit per-shop asset shards so a single-shop request stops parsing the full 517KB/2,237-item catalog.
Replace the hand-written /api/answers/export key list with one driven by a keyspace registry; it has now missed pin/dmdismissed/hookpins AND the new pc: character-tracker keyspace.
Split the shop ledger into per-event keys; the shelf/ledger writes are still two independent non-atomic puts.
Require identity on /api/shop-sell regardless of tp; an unauthenticated npc-mode caller can grow shopstate.items without bound.
Adopt a versioned key prefix; the new pc: character-tracker keyspace just repeated the same unversioned pattern this finding warned about.
Move routeQuestion into the shared vault reader and fail the build when committed secret-qids.mjs differs from a fresh computation.
Define one gated-content helper; DM-only content still uses five different hiding mechanisms.
Stamp shop-data.json with a generation id and quarantine KV shopstate entries whose shop/item no longer exists in the current build.
Extend /api/answers/export to include pin moves, dmDismissed state, and hook pins, which the nightly backup currently cannot protect at all.
Extract parseFrontmatter into a shared module; four hand-rolled vault parsers still diverge on capability.
Surface a failure in the dashboard-status write or Discord post persistently; today it only prints to a console that disappears after an unattended run.
Add a lore-audit check failing on a SPEAKER_NN label or real-name-list hit in a published page.
Cap/chunk rotationPass by elapsed time; cost scales unbounded with tick count (up to 8) times total catalog size.
Materialize a pre-filtered public projection; the anonymous path still loads 100% of DM content into memory (cheaply now, via cache, but still all of it).
Cap text length and rate-limit /api/answer, /api/sticky, /api/note POST paths.
Compute the yes-and/clarity/repetition watches over open and same-day proposals only, not the full 565-entry history.
Drop pretty-print from the export body and warn loudly on a zero-qid export instead of silently rendering duplicates.
Add a check failing when a name in daily.mjs's hardcoded settlement pool resolves to a secret page or no page.
Same as cloud-edge-worker-cpu-budget-06 (duplicate root cause): batch the /api/pin-moves sequential list+get loop with Promise.all like every other endpoint already does.
Checkpoint item-art batch save_state() per item, not once at the end of the whole batch.
Extend LORE-12's em-dash check beyond world/ to the four public artifacts and build.mjs's user-facing strings.
Log swallowed answers:snapshot PUT failures and plan sharding before the value nears 1MB.
